title: Recipe-lab candidates v1 - one record per line in content/video_engine/effects/lab/candidates.jsonl (P65 T1)
description: A candidate is ONE point of the finite combination space the lab enumerates as data (beat shape x the catalogue's members x the gates' clocks): a stable id, the shape it fills, the ordered members with their offsets, the clock values it was generated against, and where it came from - never an episode and never an allocation. The fixed reason list a judgement may cite lives ONLY in lab_judgement.schema.json ($defs.judgement.properties.reason.enum), and every tool imports it from that schema rather than restating it.

candidate_id.description: lab:<shape>:<members-digest> - the digest is the first 8 hex of the hash of the ordered members, so the id is stable across runs

card.description: a card id <axis>:<token> from docs/EFFECTS-CATALOG.jsonl (or a recipe id), resolved through authoring/effects.py so no candidate can name a token the compiler refuses

option.description: a token listed in that card's `options` (how a member names exit:wipe + wipe_right); refused when the card does not list it

offset_s.description: seconds from the candidate's first member (the first member is 0.0)

role.description: one line: what this member does IN the combination - the slot it fills in the beat shape

clocks.description: every gate value this candidate was generated against, as it stood at generation - a candidate is only ever judged on the clocks recorded here (R26-168: the fifteen proven recipes were proved against clocks that no longer exist)

m44_plate_s.description: M44's plate floor in seconds - a world plate shorter than this is a flash the eye cannot take in (6.0 today)

m16_gap_s.description: M16's event-gap ceiling in seconds - the longest the screen may go without an event (2.5 today)

m12_dock_s.description: M12's dock clock in seconds - how long a dock is held

m11_first_light_s.description: M11's first-light instant in seconds - the light lands after the build, never on arrival

page_build_end_s.description: the second the page finishes BUILDING and holds built (E99 s67); the light and the card are placed against it (7.4 today)

lp_build_s.description: LP_BUILD_S (gate_motion_density.py:242) - an axes entry's chart lands here (3.0 s); the mount's lands at page_build_end_s (7.4 s). The light slot follows the ENTRY (P65 T3, the smoke run's M11 refusal).

shape.description: the beat shape's slug from content/video_engine/effects/lab/beat-shapes.json (a plate carrying a card; a page whose number lands at +N s; a page-to-page transform; a return; the open ON the chart)

members.description: ORDERED; the first member's offset_s is 0.0

status.description: enumerated (emitted by lab_enumerate.py) -> built (rendered on the Tokyo bed) -> survivor (no gate FAIL) -> carded (on a batch card) -> approved | denied (the operator's bit) -> retired

source.description: what produced this record: the enumerator and its table ('lab_enumerate.py beat-shapes.json <shape>') or the re-proof run ('r26-168 reproof-r1 <recipe id>')

exploration.description: true when the candidate was drawn for a batch WITHOUT reference to the learner (about a quarter of each batch); the draw is seeded and the seed is recorded on the batch

calibration.description: true when a previously approved candidate rides along in a batch as a calibration probe (the log held one older than 14 days)

batch.description: the batch id this candidate was built and carded under; names content/video_engine/effects/lab/runs/<batch>.jsonl
